description: Start a playbook now. It runs in Replo as the user's automation and keeps running after this call; read it with get_task_run and the returned taskId and runId. Calling again during a run returns that run. It reuses the user's automation for the playbook, edits included. If something must be connected first, it returns needs_setup with a link for each: give the user the links, then call again. For multi-step Replo work, call skills with name "replo".

playbookId.description: A playbook id from find_playbooks, such as competitor-ad-teardown.

projectId.description: The project to run the playbook in, from list_projects.

name: run_playbook
title: Run a playbook
